description: Roads - National 250k Map Of Ireland is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tailte Éireann. Roads - National 250k Map Of Ireland All European roads (E-roads) and all roads connecting built-up areas, additionally, other roads can be included when it is needed to reach full connectivity of the transportation network (e.g. direct link between two built-up areas) or only way to reach a built-up area or isolated places (harbours, airports). Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Tailte Éireann. Its tags are 250K Map of Ireland, dgigovernment. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
